author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Midnight Deadline
challenge.description: The nightly data job is failing to finish before the store managers open the ordering app. #reliability_ruth# demands an automated validation layer to catch bad data instantly so the morning window is never missed again. #data_dave# insists on keeping the process manual for now, arguing that the infrastructure costs are too high and the current manual checks are sufficient to manage the risk.

output.content: I am pushing for a formal review on the data versioning step. We need to guarantee that every dataset used for training is fully auditable. The more we can trace back to the exact source of our features, the better we stand when a forecast fails. I want this review to be comprehensive, covering not just the raw point of sale lines but also the promotion calendar and supplier lead times. This is not about adding a single check. I want a deep, structural validation that proves our data lineage is intact. The goal is to make our model inputs so transparent that any discrepancy becomes impossible to hide. I am asking for the strongest possible governance here because the cost of a silent data error is too high to ignore.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly requests the strongest possible governance and comprehensive coverage, indicating that exceeding the minimum requirements would better satisfy their need for maximum auditability and transparency.
